title: People
markdown:
**What it is:** Your org roster — the humans the Executive coordinates with, each with a response SLA, preferred channel, and the approval authority they hold.

**What it does:**

- Add people with their role, email, and chat IDs (Slack / Discord / Telegram).
- Set a response SLA so the Executive knows when a proposal is overdue.
- Assign **authority scopes** (e.g. approve spend under $10k, sign off on hiring) so proposals route to the right person.
- Mark the principal (you / the founder) and set availability or on-leave dates.

**How to use:**

1. Open **People** and click **+ Add person**.
2. Enter **Full name** (the only required field) and **Role**. If this is you, tick **This is me — Primary** — this can only be set when adding someone.
3. Expand **Contact & routing**: the preferred channel, **Expected reply within *N* hours** (their SLA — default 24), email, and Slack / Discord / Telegram IDs. Those IDs are also what lets this person talk to the Executive on those channels.
4. Expand **Approval authority** and click each scope they hold:

   | Button | They can approve |
   |---|---|
   | Spend <$2K / <$10K / >$10K | Spend up to that amount (>$10K covers large spend) |
   | Hiring | Hiring sign-off |
   | Vendors | New vendor onboarding |
   | Credit | Customer credits |
   | Legal | Legal signatures |
   | Board | Board communications |
   | All | Everything — usually the founder |

5. Click **Add person**. Later, open the person and click **Edit** to set **On leave until**, add **Availability windows** (days, hours, timezone), or change their scopes; **Archive person** retires them from the roster.

**Example from chat:** *"Add Sarah Chen as our fractional CFO — sarah@acme.com — she approves spend under $10k and usually replies within 48 hours."* Or open **+ Add person**, press **Ctrl/Cmd + .**, and describe the person — Ask OE fills in the dialog for you to check and save.

*Note: authority scopes are how the Executive figures out who to ask for any given approval.*
